items.so_what_text: Prioritize Innovation & Investment: recovering the 1.4-point deficit against the cohort moves overall maturity more than any at-parity category can [E-007].
items.title: Innovation & Investment trails peers by 1.4
items.what_text: Innovation Themes is one of Capital Farm Credit's least developed strategy and governance capabilities, scoring 1.5 out of 5 in Zennify's latest assessment, below the 3.0 typically seen at comparable institutions. It underpins the planning and oversight the rest of the business relies on, so where it stands today directly shapes Capital Farm Credit's ability to deliver sharper strategic direction and stronger oversight [E-108].
items.why_text: The peer benchmark for Innovation & Investment is 3.0; at 1.6 this institution operates 1.4 points behind the peers it competes with for the same customers [E-129, E-108].

items.so_what_text: Start with Customer Journeys & Servicing — a focused program here recovers peer parity fastest and unlocks the downstream capabilities that depend on it [E-007].

items.why_text: Peers score 2.8 on Customer Journeys & Servicing against this institution's 1.6 — the 1.1-point shortfall shows up in every capability rolled into this category [E-065, E-108].
